observations: Photo 0: Open laptop showing Windows desktop with a dock wallpaper. Keyboard is black with silver frame. 'ELITEBOOK' written on palm rest. Intel Core i5 sticker visible. Screen bezels are thin, especially top and sides. Background shows glass display cabinets with electronics and boxes.
Photo 1: Closed laptop lid, silver/white finish, HP logo centered. Held by a hand with a silver watch. Background shows shelves with boxes and glass cabinets.
Photo 2: Side view of closed laptop, same silver/white finish, HP logo visible. Held at an angle, showing thickness and edge. Background includes cardboard boxes and a blue box labeled 'ASPEC'.

claims.claim: Clean hp elitebook 830 g8 ultrabook in excellent working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show the laptop is clean and powered on, but no proof of internal condition, battery health, or full functionality. The 'excellent working condition' claim cannot be verified remotely.
These are subjective qualities. 'Fast' depends on specs and usage; 'premium' and 'durable' are not measurable from photos. No specs or performance data provided.

risks.risk: Battery health is unknown; may not hold a charge or may be degraded.
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop running on battery for 10 minutes with screen brightness at 50% and no external power.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery may be dead or degraded

risks.risk: Internal components (RAM, SSD, cooling) may be faulty or not as advertised.
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop running a benchmark or stress test (e.g., CPU and GPU load) for 5 minutes without crashing or overheating.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or underperforming

risks.risk: Screen may have dead pixels, burn-in, or backlight issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the screen displaying solid white, black, and red screens for 10 seconds each.
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen may have defects

risks.risk: Keyboard or trackpad may be unresponsive or damaged.
risks.proof: A video showing typing on all keys and using the trackpad to move cursor and click.
risks.if_unproven: priced as input devices may be faulty

proof_requests: Video of the laptop running on battery for 10 minutes.
Video of the laptop under load (CPU/GPU stress test) for 5 minutes.
Video of the screen displaying solid white, black, and red for 10 seconds each.
Video of typing on all keys and using the trackpad.
Photo or video showing the bottom of the laptop to check for damage or missing screws.
response.reason: The model is identifiable as HP EliteBook 830 G8, but critical claims about working condition and performance cannot be verified from photos alone. Hidden risks related to battery, internal components, screen, and input devices require video proof before pricing can be determined.
